page_title: SEV 1-0 OSA | Sevilla v Osasuna 08/11/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+10' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+10' The ball goes out of play. Osasuna are awarded a corner kick.

90+9' Post! Chidera Ejuke (Sevilla) latches on to a sweet pass inside the box and unleashes a shot which only hits the right post. What an unlucky moment for him. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Osasuna.
90+6' Batista Mendy (Sevilla) commits an ugly challenge. The referee sees it and immediately blows his whistle. A free kick has been awarded to Osasuna.
90+4' Osasuna earn a corner.
90+3' Is that a yellow card in the referee's hand? It is! Batista Mendy (Sevilla) gets booked.
90+3' The foul by Iker Munoz (Osasuna) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Miguel Ortiz.
90+1' Iker Munoz (Osasuna) commits a foul and Miguel Ortiz immediately signals a free kick. Sevilla win a free kick.
90+1' Moi Gomez (Osasuna) floats the free kick into the box, but it's easily cleared by the first man.
90' 9 additional min. will be played.
90' 5:4 – the corner kicks stats.
87' Matias Almeyda has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Chidera Ejuke (Sevilla) replacing Ruben Vargas.
86' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Juanlu Sanchez as he is replaced by Manuel Bueno Sebastian (Sevilla).
85' The fouls committed statistics – 16:10.
83' Gabriel Suazo (Sevilla) is awarded a yellow card for his behaviour.
81' The referee signals a substitution. Jorge Herrando (Osasuna) is brought on as a substitute for Flavien Boyomo.

80' Marcao (Sevilla) outjumps the defence to meet the resulting corner and heads the ball towards the right side of the goal. The long-range header is not powerful enough, and the keeper comfortably makes a save.
79' The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Sevilla.

78' Akor Adams (Sevilla) does well to control a poor pass on the edge of the box then shoots towards the bottom right corner. Sergio Herrera is out of position but leaps to make a brilliant save. The ball goes out of play. Sevilla are awarded a corner kick.
78' Gabriel Suazo (Sevilla) sends in a lofted cross from a mid-range free kick. His effort, however, goes out of play. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Osasuna.
77' Alejandro Catena (Osasuna) brings an opponent down and Miguel Ortiz interrupts the game. Sevilla are awarded a free kick.
76' Matias Almeyda prepares a substitution. Peque is replaced by Alfonso Gonzalez (Sevilla).
72' Marcao (Sevilla) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.
70' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Ruben Garcia departs the field of play to be replaced by Sheraldo Becker (Osasuna).
69' Peque (Sevilla) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
69' Ruben Garcia (Osasuna) whips a long ball in from the free kick which is intercepted by Odysseas Vlachodimos.
67' The attendance for today's match is 35169.
65' Here is a change. Djibril Sow is going off and Matias Almeyda gives the last tactical orders to Nemanja Gudelj (Sevilla).
65' GOAL DISALLOWED! Controversy and anger as Akor Adams (Sevilla) has a goal ruled out, incredibly, for offside.
63' Osasuna seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
61' It's like he was asking for a caution. Jon Moncayola (Osasuna) receives a yellow card.
60' Jon Moncayola (Osasuna) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.
58' Tanguy Nianzou (Sevilla) commits a rough challenge and Miguel Ortiz blows his whistle for an infringement. There is a free kick near the sideline to Osasuna.

56' What a chance that is! Abel Bretones (Osasuna) finds himself unmarked in a promising position after receiving a cross on the edge of the box and his attempt sails a whisker wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Sevilla will have a goal kick.
54' Kike Barja (Osasuna) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
54' Kike Barja goes off the pitch and Aimar Oroz (Osasuna) comes on.
53' Dangerous play by Batista Mendy (Sevilla). Miguel Ortiz blows his whistle for a foul. Free kick. Osasuna will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
51' 1 - 0 GOAL! That’s a great strike from the spot by Ruben Vargas (Sevilla) into the left of the net, giving goalkeeper Sergio Herrera no chance!
50' Ruben Vargas (Sevilla) is going to take the penalty!
50' It’s a PENALTY to Sevilla after the VAR review!
49' Referee Miguel Ortiz makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether it’s a penalty for Sevilla. Let’s see what happens!
49' The game is interrupted now, Juanlu Sanchez (Sevilla) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
47' Surely that's handball by one of the Osasuna players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!
47' The ball is out of play. Sevilla win a corner kick.

46' Akor Adams (Sevilla) meets a delivery on the edge of the penalty area and shoots towards the top right corner. He didn't put enough power into the effort, though, and Sergio Herrera pulls off an easy save. Good work from Sevilla as they win a corner.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+2' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+2' A yellow card for a tackle by Tanguy Nianzou (Sevilla). Miguel Ortiz doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
45' The fourth official shows 1 min. of added time.
43' Sevilla force their opponents to concede a corner.
43' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Gabriel Suazo (Sevilla). The referee blows his whistle, Sevilla are awarded a corner kick.
41' Sevilla are ruled offside.
40' The ball goes out of play and Sevilla have been awarded a corner kick.
38' Djibril Sow (Sevilla) attempted to pick out a free teammate inside the box, but Sergio Herrera comes off the line to clear the ball away.
37' A quickly taken corner by Osasuna.
36' Ruben Garcia (Osasuna) takes the ball to the corner flag and sends it into the box.
34' Ruben Vargas (Sevilla) pulls the shirt of his opponent and only escapes without punishment due to the benevolence of the referee. A free kick is awarded to Osasuna.
31' The Sevilla players are exchanging some short passes.
28' Miguel Ortiz shows a yellow card to Djibril Sow (Sevilla) for a tough tackle.
28' The referee points to the corner flag and Sevilla will take a corner.
23' Jon Moncayola (Osasuna) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
21' Victor Munoz (Osasuna) gets booked for the first time in this match.
20' Jose Angel Carmona (Sevilla) will miss the next game because of that yellow card.
20' Jose Angel Carmona (Sevilla) can't expect anything else than a yellow card for his hard tackle. And a yellow it is. Miguel Ortiz didn't think twice about pulling it out of his pocket.
18' Osasuna will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
18' Kike Barja (Osasuna) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
16' The possession of the ball – 62:38.
12' The ball is out of play and Osasuna manage to earn a corner.
11' Miguel Ortiz blows his whistle. Djibril Sow (Sevilla) commits a foul after dangerous play. Osasuna are awarded the free kick.
9' Sevilla are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.

6' Iker Munoz (Osasuna) manages to dispossess his opponent of the ball, but he commits a foul in the process and the referee blows his whistle. It's a free kick to Sevilla, but they probably won't attempt a direct shot on goal from here.
2' Great teamplay by Sevilla as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are on the pitch and Osasuna will have the kick-off.
Today's referee will be Miguel Ortiz.
